name: stale-flag-cleanup
description: PoC: background agent removes stale Featurevisor flags using Tinybird SQL evidence

scripts.infra:bootstrap: pnpm --filter @stale-flags/infra exec cdk bootstrap aws://$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text)/us-east-1
scripts.infra:agent-run: aws stepfunctions start-execution --state-machine-arn "$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name StaleFlagsStack --region us-east-1 --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='AgentStateMachineArn'].OutputValue" --output text)" --region us-east-1 --query 'executionArn' --output text
scripts.qa:agent: echo "Follow docs/qa-agent.md and write a canvas under ~/.cursor/projects/Users-lucamezzalira-Documents-tinybird/canvases/qa-run-<stamp>.canvas.tsx"
